skills.name: SQLMap scan profile: Keep the baseline profile
skills.description: Use the safest app profile as the comparison point for every assessment.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Begin with app defaults: level 1, risk 1, BEU, one thread, 10-second timeout, and one retry.
2. Change one profile value only when written scope permits and the owner understands added request volume.
3. Leave level/risk/technique/threads unset so app applies level 1, risk 1, BEU, one thread; record these values.
4. Stop on 429/503, unusual latency, or service degradation; do not raise load to overcome a block.

Safety: scan only owner-authorized scope using web.sqlmap and uthorized_target=true. Do not dump records, open shells, access server files, evade controls, or perform destructive actions.
